svg.title: Binary search for an exact match
svg.desc: Searching a sorted array for the value 40. Each step compares the middle element to the target and discards half the remaining range, until the target is found at index 6.
svg.text: low = 0, high = 7, mid = 3 → 18 < 40, search right half
low = 4, high = 7, mid = 5 → 31 < 40, search right half
low = 6, high = 7, mid = 6 → 40 = target, found at index 6
